title: Where a release goes
description: Every tool (zazzle, zazzled, zazzle-csharp-indexer, afs, fix-network, free-disk-space) is released together, one version for all, with cyberspace-generator, which is built in the cyberspace-explorer repository and shipped at the release pinned in macos/release/cyberspace-generator.version, by the release workflow on a v* tag. It runs on each developer's own machine; these are the places a version is installed from.

entities.title: GitHub release
entities.summary: One release per vX.Y.Z tag, with no release notes, holding zazzle-macos-universal.tar.gz (five universal binaries and the C# indexer gzipped for arm64 and x64), the Linux tarballs for x86_64 and aarch64 (zazzle, zazzled, zazzle-csharp-indexer), their checksums and the Homebrew bottle.
entities.purpose: The canonical copy of each version; the formula's bottle and its source fallback download from it.
entities.deployedBy: The release workflow (macos, linux and homebrew jobs)
entities.rollback: No rollback is automated or documented. Each tag keeps its own release, so an earlier version stays downloadable.

sources.symbol: linux: Attach to the GitHub release
homebrew: Build the bottle and add it to the release

entities.title: icelander.net/downloads
entities.summary: The same tarballs and checksums, copied to the download bucket under zazzle/<tag>/ and zazzle/latest/, served at https://icelander.net/downloads/zazzle/.
entities.environment: The icelander-downloads bucket on Cloudflare R2
entities.purpose: A stable latest/ link for the README's curl install, and one folder per version.
entities.deployedBy: The release workflow, with the secret CLOUDFLARE_R2_TOKEN
entities.promotedFrom: The same job's build; there is no staging.
entities.rollback: No rollback is automated or documented. latest/ is overwritten by each release; zazzle/<tag>/ keeps every version.

entities.title: Homebrew tap zazzcat/homebrew-z
entities.summary: One formula, zazzle, in the external tap zazzcat/homebrew-z, pointing at the release's tarball and bottle; it installs every macOS binary and expands the C# indexer for the Mac's CPU after install. Users run brew install zazzcat/z/zazzle, which adds the tap on first use.
entities.environment: Formula/zazzle.rb on the default branch of zazzcat/homebrew-z, read by brew
entities.purpose: Installs and upgrades without a Gatekeeper prompt, since Homebrew does not quarantine what a formula installs.
entities.deployedBy: The release workflow's homebrew job, pushing to the tap with the secret HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN
entities.rollback: No rollback is automated or documented. Each release moves the formula to the new tag; the tap's git history keeps the earlier formulas.
